goal: Determine whether china-water-quality-monitoring-rd and china-water-regulation-enforcement are distinct assignment cases or duplicate records.
note: Consolidated duplicate: both records described the same variation case (He, Wang, Zhang 2020 QJE, spatial RD at water quality monitoring stations). Retained china-water-quality-monitoring-rd as canonical; deprecated china-water-regulation-enforcement with redirect. Enhanced retained record with political-incentive mechanism and extended time range (2000-2014).

goal: Determine whether the two Huai heating records share one policy-boundary assignment and should become one variation with multiple design applications.
note: Consolidated Huai River heating records: both describe the same variation (Huai River-Qinling Mountains heating boundary spatial RD, established 1950s). Assignment mechanism, treatment/control definitions, and core identification strategy are identical. Differences are in papers (Almond et al. 2009 vs Ito and Zhang 2020), outcomes (mortality vs WTP), time periods, and econometric methods -- all captured as distinct design_applications. Retained china-huai-river-heating-air-pollution as canonical; deprecated china-heating-policy-air-pollution-wtp with redirect. Updated cross-reference in china-pollution-information-disclosure.

goal: Verify primary HNTE policy documents, exact R&D thresholds, and data sources for china-rd-tax-notch.
note: Grounded china-rd-tax-notch from extracted to grounded. Key corrections: (1) sample period corrected from 2005-2014 to 2006-2011; (2) R&D thresholds corrected from generic 3-6% to exact size-dependent 3%/4%/6% with pre-2008 uniform 5% documented; (3) pre-2008 33%->15% rate added; (4) relabeling detection mechanism (R&D as subcategory of Administrative Expenses) fully documented; (5) primary policy evidence (Guo Ke Fa Huo 2008 No.172) verified from MOST official website; (6) design.claim_type set to causal; (7) access_level and locator added to all evidence items; (8) china_relevance replaced with case-specific text. First record to reach grounded status.

goal: Audit the six contested structural, descriptive, or observational records for catalog admissibility and source accuracy; retain as leads, consolidate into valid assignments, or deprecate with redirects without deleting evidence.
note: Catalog admissibility audit of 6 contested records. Deprecated 3: china-firm-dynamics-reallocation (productivity decomposition, no assignment mechanism), china-growing-like-china (structural calibration model), china-trade-migration-productivity (duplicate of china-hukou-migration-productivity). Kept contested 3: china-from-imitation-to-innovation (endogenous policy allocation + structural), china-hukou-migration-productivity (quantitative spatial equilibrium), china-social-ties-political-elite (observational, endogenous ties, and has framing error). All 6 classified as low maintenance priority. Established tier framework for remaining records.

goal: Build and verify a province/county-year rollout table for rural tax and fee reform.
note: Grounded from extracted: verified multi-phase rollout timeline (1994-1999 county pilots, 2000-2003 Phase 1, 2004-2006 Phase 2), documented reform content (Three Cancellations Two Adjustments One Reform), added 3 design applications (Zhou&Chen 2005, Chen 2017 JPubE, Zhou&Chen 2015), set design.claim_type=causal, added 5 evidence items with access_level and locator, province-level rollout table verified from central documents, county-level implementation timing remains a partial blocker.

goal: Audit first-wave low-carbon pilot selection, province-city nesting, and local implementation timing.
note: Audited and grounded first-wave low-carbon pilot record. Verified NDRC Climate [2010]1587 first-wave list and selection criteria; documented province-city nesting (5 provinces + 8 cities, with province-level pilots exposing all prefectures); added second-wave NDRC Climate [2012]3760 for staggered-structure context; added access_level/locator to all evidence items; set design.claim_type=causal; added two high-quality design applications (Ma et al. 2021 IJERPH green innovation; Yu & Zhang 2021 Energy Economics carbon emission efficiency); updated readiness blockers for local implementation timing, nesting rules, and concurrent policies.

goal: Audit the wind-direction IV transfer profile against Chinese pollution-source, monitor, weather, and health-data feasibility.
note: Audited wind-direction IV transfer to China; added evidence E3-E5, method_transfer details, readiness blockers, and transfer limits. Kept status extracted (method-inspiration) because China lacks daily county-level mortality/claims equivalent and no study replicates full US county-day design.

goal: Resolve local implementation timing and policy components for the 2014 hukou reform case.
note: Resolved that the 2014 hukou reform creates two distinct assignment structures (national 5m city-size threshold and staggered local unified-hukou adoption), but kept status extracted because local adoption dates rely on paper-reported tables rather than independently verified primary documents and the two designs should not be conflated.
